gallery.searchLabel: Search clips by name or game
gallery.copied: File copied: paste it in Discord or File Explorer.

status.title: PalaClips status
status.fellBack: Window not found: capturing the screen instead.

roster.title: Audio tracks
roster.empty: No audio track: clips will be silent. Turn on the full mix, the mic or an app on the Audio page.

clips.title: Latest clips
clips.emptyWithKeys: Press {keys} in game to save the last seconds.
clips.emptyNoKeys: Pick a save hotkey in Settings → Hotkeys.

settings.title: Settings
settings.restartWarning: Applying restarts the replay: the seconds in memory will be lost.

general.autostartHelp: Starts in the notification area, with no window.
general.soundHelp: Played for every saved clip, even in game.
general.toastHelp: Windows delays it while a game is fullscreen.
general.diagnosticHelp: A zip with the logs, anonymized settings and system info.
general.resetHelp: Every setting goes back to its default value, hotkeys included.

hotkeys.listeningHint: Press the combination, Escape to cancel, Backspace to remove.
hotkeys.listeningHelp: If nothing shows up, another application already uses the combination. Escape cancels, Backspace removes the hotkey.
hotkeys.unavailable: Already used by another application: pick another combination.
hotkeys.readers: Discord and the NVIDIA overlay don't register their hotkeys with Windows, so PalaClips can't detect conflicts with them: check them yourself (Discord: Settings → Keybinds; NVIDIA: Alt+Z → Settings → Keyboard shortcuts).

storage.gameNamesHelp: New clips from each game go into a subfolder with this name.
storage.quotaHelp: Past this size, the oldest non-favorite clips are permanently deleted, not sent to the Recycle Bin.

quotaConfirm.one: {count} clip (the oldest) will be permanently deleted ({size}). It won't go to the Recycle Bin.
quotaConfirm.other: The {count} oldest clips will be permanently deleted ({size}). They won't go to the Recycle Bin.

replay.ramAlert: This buffer would take {percent}% of the free RAM ({free}).
replay.bufferHelp: On disk for long replays, without using RAM.
replay.codecUnavailable: Not available on this graphics card: {codecs}.
replay.codecFallbackCpu: {codec} isn't available on the processor: {fallback} is used instead.
replay.encoderCpuNoGpu: No encoder on the graphics card: the processor encodes the video. In game, expect about 1 core at 1080p30.
replay.encoderCpu: Encoding on the processor: in game, expect about 1 core at 1080p30, and the game may lose fps.
replay.keyframesHelp: Shorter: the clip starts closer to the moment you want.
replay.gpuPriority: When the GPU is maxed out
replay.gpuPriorityHelp: Capture first: smooth video, but the game loses about 7% fps.

capture.borderHelp: Around the captured area, visible on screen but not in clips.

audio.nameTaken: “{name}” is already the name of another track.
audio.palaclipsSoundsIncluded: PalaClips sounds are recorded in it.
audio.desktopLabel: Put all desktop audio in {name} instead of the sum of the tracks
audio.inFullMixLabel: Also put the microphone in the {name} track
audio.followsWindow: Follows the app of the captured window
audio.followsForeground: Follows the game in the foreground

manyTracks.one: {count} app track beyond {calm} adds about {cpu}% of a CPU core, {memory} of RAM and up to {size} per clip minute.
manyTracks.other: {count} app tracks beyond {calm} add about {cpu}% of a CPU core, {memory} of RAM and up to {size} per clip minute.

calibration.title: Sync calibration
calibration.warning: The primary screen turns black and flashes, with a beep every second, for about 15 s.
calibration.warningArmed: The replay then restarts: the seconds in memory will be lost.
calibration.micHint: If you use headphones, hold one earcup against the mic so it picks up the beeps.
calibration.voicemeeter: The delay of a Voicemeeter or LightHost chain can change on every restart: recalibrate after restarting it.
calibration.micNotMeasured: not measured: if you use headphones, hold one earcup against the mic and recalibrate

recording.splitMinutes: Length of each file in minutes
recording.splitMegabytes: Size of each file in megabytes
recording.includeReplaySeparate: Quality differs from the replay: the replay in memory is saved as a separate clip, just before the recording.

messages.no_hardware_encoder: no graphics card encoder worked: update your graphics driver, or pick “Processor” in Settings → Replay & quality
messages.no_video_encoder: no video encoder worked, neither on the graphics card nor on the processor: update Windows and your graphics driver, then restart PalaClips
messages.codec_unavailable: PalaClips can't encode {codec} on this PC with the chosen encoder: pick another codec
messages.unsupported_windows_build: per-app audio capture needs Windows 11 (build 20348 or later): update Windows
messages.primary_monitor_missing: capture target not found: no primary screen
messages.monitor_missing: capture target not found: screen {name} isn't connected
messages.window_missing: capture target not found: no {exe} window is open
messages.output_too_large: video output refused: {codec} is limited to {limit} px per side and the video would be {width}×{height}: pick a lower output resolution or another codec
messages.output_unsupported: video output refused: the graphics card refuses to encode {width}×{height} at {fps} fps in {codec}: pick a lower output resolution or another codec
messages.track_stopped: audio capture failed: the “{track}” track stopped
messages.captured_window_closed: the capture source is gone: the captured window was closed
messages.video_capture_stopped: the capture source is gone: video capture stopped
messages.no_stream: no replay to save: no stream
messages.clip_too_short: Nothing new to save: less than {seconds} s since the last clip.
messages.replay_stopped: The replay stopped: {reason}. Arm it again once the source is back.
messages.encoder_reset: Capture was interrupted ({reason}): PalaClips is restarting it. A recording in progress continues in a new file.
messages.capture_fallback_monitor: The “{title}” window can't be captured: PalaClips captures its screen instead.
messages.capture_source_rate_limited: Windows only composes your screen at {rate} Hz while you record at {fps} fps: the video will repeat frames. Turn off G-Sync for this screen, or set your other screens to at least {fps} Hz.
messages.capture_exclusive_fullscreen: The game runs in exclusive fullscreen: Windows can't capture its image, so the video freezes. {advice}
messages.cpu_encoder_overloaded: Your processor can't encode the video in time: frames are repeated or skipped. Lower the resolution or frame rate in Settings → Replay & quality (720p30 is the lightest).
messages.capture_gpu_saturated: Your GPU is maxed out: PalaClips can't get GPU time, so the video stutters. Cap the game's fps to leave some headroom, or pick “Capture first” in Settings → Replay & quality.
messages.app_track_silent: “{track}” track: {app} plays sound but the track stays silent. Check that the app doesn't use an output in exclusive mode, then restart it.
messages.device_in_exclusive_use: another application uses the device in exclusive mode. PalaClips retries every second; turn off exclusive mode in that application to record it.
messages.no_audio_device: no audio device available ({detail}). The track stays silent until it's back.
messages.internal_error: PalaClips internal error: restart the application.
messages.settings_read_only: Settings are read-only: they come from a newer version of PalaClips.
messages.settings_newer: Your settings come from a newer version of PalaClips (format {version}): PalaClips uses default settings for this session and leaves the file untouched. Update PalaClips to get them back.
messages.settings_unreadable: Your settings couldn't be read ({detail}) and were reset.
messages.settings_unreadable_kept: Your settings couldn't be read ({detail}) and were reset. The old file was kept in {backup}.
messages.settings_dir_missing: Settings folder not found: settings won't be saved.
messages.autostart_unreadable: Couldn't read the Start with Windows setting: {detail}.
messages.autostart_not_disabled: Couldn't turn off Start with Windows: {detail}.
messages.hotkey_tab: “{keys}”: Tab moves between controls; pick another key.
messages.hotkey_windows_key: “{keys}”: Windows reserves hotkeys that use the Windows key; pick another combination.
messages.hotkey_system: “{keys}” is a Windows or game shortcut: pick another combination.
messages.hotkey_needs_modifier: “{keys}”: add Ctrl, Alt or Shift, otherwise the key would stop working in game.
messages.hotkey_shift_types: “{keys}”: Shift alone with a letter or digit types text; add Ctrl or Alt.
messages.hotkeys_taken: {keys} is already used by another application: your previous hotkeys were kept.
messages.hotkey_unavailable: {keys} is already used by another application, often the NVIDIA overlay (Alt+F10 and Alt+Shift+F10 are its replay keys). Turn this shortcut off in the overlay (Alt+Z → Settings → Keyboard shortcuts) or pick another one in Settings → Hotkeys.
messages.disk_almost_full: Clips drive almost full: {free_mb} MB free. Recording stops below 300 MB.
messages.library_loading: The clip library is still loading: try again in a moment.
messages.name_forbidden_characters: “{name}” can't be used as a file name: remove the characters < > : " / \ | ? * ™ ® ©, double spaces and leading or trailing dots or spaces.
messages.name_reserved: “{name}” is reserved by Windows: pick another one.
messages.clip_unknown: This clip is no longer in the library.
messages.quota_deleted: Quota reached: the oldest clips were permanently deleted ({count}, {size_mb} MB freed).
messages.export_too_short: the trimmed clip must be at least half a second long
messages.update_available: PalaClips {version} is available: install it in Settings → General → Updates.
messages.update_while_recording: a recording is in progress: stop it before installing the update
messages.update_none: no update to install: check again
messages.exclusive_fullscreen_advice: Switch the game to borderless (windowed fullscreen) in its display settings.
messages.exclusive_fullscreen_advice_minecraft: Minecraft Java: leave fullscreen (F11) and maximize the window, or install a borderless fullscreen mod such as Borderless Fullscreen.
messages.clip_cut_short: Clip stopped early: {reason}. The start is kept.
messages.not_a_video: This file has no readable video track.
messages.target_too_small: Target too small for this length: it needs at least {min_mb} MB.
messages.over_target: The file is still over the target after three attempts: pick a lower resolution or a larger target.
messages.record_encoder_cpu: The graphics card refused a second encode ({reason}): the recording is encoded by the processor.

player.noAudio: This clip has no audio track.

export.title: Trim
export.fastHelp: Fast: starts at the previous keyframe, without re-encoding.
export.preciseHelp: Exact: re-encoded from the exact frame, slower to export.
export.noTracks: No track: the trimmed clip will be silent.
export.name: File name
export.mixDoubled: The full mix already includes the app tracks: with “Mixed”, their sound plays twice.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.favorite: Add to or remove from favorites
shortcuts.cutPoints: Set trim start or end at the current position
shortcuts.jumpCut: Go to the trim start or end

checks.title: Before you start
checks.windowsOld: Build {build}: per-app audio capture needs Windows 11 (build 20348 or later).
checks.encoderMissing: No encoder worked, neither on the graphics card nor on the processor. Update Windows and your graphics driver, then restart PalaClips.
checks.encoderCpu: No encoder on the graphics card: the processor will encode the video ({codecs}). In game, expect about 1 core at 1080p30, and the game may lose fps. To encode on the graphics card, update its driver.
checks.folderReadOnly: PalaClips can't write to {path}. Pick another folder at the “Where should clips go?” question.
